name: Christian Attributes
overview: Scripture calls Christians to pursue spiritual maturity and holiness, reflecting the perfection of our heavenly Father (Matthew 5:48). Believers are urged to stand firm in the freedom Christ has secured, avoiding the bondage of sin (Galatians 5:1). The fruit of the Spirit—such as love, joy, peace, and faith—marks the character of a Christ-centered life (Galatians 5:22). Wisdom is granted generously by God to those who ask (James 1:5), and mutual confession and fervent prayer among believers have powerful healing effects (James 5:16). The church is warned against mere outward appearances of life that mask spiritual deadness (Revelation 3:1), emphasizing the need for genuine transformation in Christian attributes.
